question: At what time between 3 and 4 o'clock will the minute and hour hands be at right angles?
explanation: At 3 o'clock, hands are 15 min spaces apart. For right angle (15 min spaces), minute hand must gain (15+15) = 30 min spaces or (15-15) = 0. Minute hand gains 55 min spaces in 60 min. Time = (30 × 60)/55 = 360/11 = 32 8/11 min past 3.
